decisions.evidence_boundary: every result in this lane is fixture evidence. The 'reviewer' in test_semantic_review_stage1b4_closure.py is a fake that writes a JSON file; the evaluator tests feed synthetic stream-json. No real issue-design-reviewer SubAgent was started by CI and none is started by any migrated Python (the Agent tool launch stays the orchestrator's job). Live SubAgent evidence, if any, is recorded separately and never inferred from this lane.
decisions.no_skip_policy: 0 skipped / 0 xfailed / 0 deselected; deferred_tests is empty. The two claude_live runtime-smoke files are not migrated (not_adopted_source_tests) instead of being hidden behind a deselect marker.
decisions.repository_identity: no semantic-review script or test carries a repository slug; nothing here reads or defaults a repo. scripts/ci/check_no_functional_slug.py (stage0-closure) scans .claude and schemas stay slug-free.
decisions.agent_hygiene_AC3: the only 'LOOP_PROTOCOL' occurrence (persona sentence of issue-design-reviewer.md) became 'agent-platform'; the frontmatter and every behavioural rule are untouched. Markdown is exempt from the slug scanner, so this is a naming cleanup, not a gate workaround.

decisions.deadline_contract_note: Issue #15 lists 'deadline-exceeded late-result rejection'. The source semantic_review_transport / join_review_results / trigger contain no deadline concept (no 'deadline' in any of the three scripts or their tests); the deadline logic belongs to reviewer_transport (Stage 1b-3a, already migrated and tested). The semantic lane's late/stale guards are completed_at <= pinned_at (foreground_not_verified) and result mtime < pinned_at (stale_result_reused); both are tested end to end. No deadline was invented here (verbatim migration, no new gate).
decisions.closure_extractors: the evaluator tests (288 of them) call two pure stream-json parsers of the source's 11k-line scripts/agent-ops/run_worktree_agent_runtime_smoke.py (live claude / herdr launch runner = Stage 3). Only extract_claude_permission_denials, extract_claude_hook_lifecycle_events and their two private helpers + one constant were extracted into scripts/agent-ops/claude_stream_extractors.py (no process launch, no filesystem, no network). The runner itself is NOT migrated. The input wire contract is the native Claude Code one (hooks reference, common input fields): the hook payload and outer stream event are read via `session_id` (outer also `sessionId`); `session_ref`/`sessionRef` inputs are only a lower-priority compatibility fallback. Only the normalised OUTPUT field is named `session_ref`.
decisions.stage_boundaries: issue-reviewer (legacy) is Out of Scope of Parent #5; issue-editor / issue-creator and every GitHub mutation are Stage 2; claude_live smoke and the runner are Stage 3; nothing of Stage 2 / I-4 / Stage 3 / Issue #27 is implemented.
decisions.deadline_contract_status: RESOLVED by explicit human limited approval dated 2026-10-24 (Issue #15 / PR #28 only): the semantic-review own deadline-exceeded late-result rejection is excluded from this migration's required conditions because the source has none. completed_at<=pinned_at / mtime / body-SHA remain staleness guards and are NOT evidence of deadline rejection; no deadline was implemented and no TTL/deadline gate was added. Stage 1b-3a reviewer_transport deadline handling is separate. Not a general AC relaxation.
decisions.extractor_authority_note: scripts/agent-ops/claude_stream_extractors.py is ratified for Issue #15 / PR #28 only by explicit human limited approval dated 2026-10-24 (pure stream-json parser needed by the Stage 1b-4 evaluator test closure; native hook key session_id kept; Stage 3 live runner NOT migrated; Ruff exclusions not widened; Parent #5 general Allowed Paths unchanged).

intentional_diffs: join_review_results.py: findings are validated (list of dicts with severity in blocker/high/medium/low) and enum inputs are type-checked; malformed findings / unhashable enums are treated as a transport failure instead of approving (unknown severity) or raising (reviewer B M1/M2). Valid blocker/high findings still win. One of two deviations from verbatim in the three scripts (the other is below). retry_already_attempted must be a real bool (TypeError otherwise; the CLI no longer applies bool()). Only None is normalised to an empty list; every other non-list value, including falsy {} / '' / 0 / False / (), is malformed input and fails closed (Defect A, PR #28 re-review).

semantic_review_transport.py: record_result no longer normalises raw findings with `or []`; a non-list or missing raw `findings` (including {} / false / 0 / "" / null) is rejected via the existing invalid_findings_shape path and no artifact is persisted. A valid empty list is still accepted. Second (and last) deviation from verbatim in the three scripts. No new schema or gate.
